data.description: Discover the breathtaking oasis nestled amidst lush gardens and glistening lakes. Green Community offers the seamless integration of natural beauty and luxury living.

data.answer:
Green Community is a suburban neighborhood considered a peaceful haven for families. It is one of the most sought-after locations for purchasing villas in Motor City.

Its neighboring sub-communities include Oia Residence, Rabdan Building, and Eden Apartments. Notable residential clusters in the Green Community with villas and townhouses include Casa Flores and Casa Familia.

You can find many high-end residential properties in Green Community Dubai, from conveniently located apartments to spacious villas. The area has 127 villas, 159 townhouses, and a few apartment buildings. However, the Green Community Motor City terraced apartments are more spacious than other communities. The district also offers round-the-clock security and family-friendly facilities, such as jogging and biking tracks, a health club, playgrounds, and parks. 

Renting a Property in Motor City's Green Community

The low-rise terraced apartments for rent in Green Community Motor City Dubai are available for a starting price of AED 285k. The Green Community Motor City villas for rent are available for AED 240k per year. Note that a limited number of properties are available for rent in the Green Community.

Buying a Property in Green Community, Motor City

There is a selection of apartments available for purchase in the Green Community called Terraced Apartments. These units provide amazing views of the lakes and gardens. A 3-bedroom flat in Green Community typically ranges from AED 2.1M to AED 3.4M. The price variation is primarily due to the covered areas, ranging from 3,300 sq. ft. to 4,364 sq. ft. If you're interested in a 4-bedroom apartment in Green Community, you must pay around AED 3M.

The community's covered area for luxury houses is over 7,000 sq. ft. Those considering a move can choose from an array of villas and townhouses. The lowest asking price for a 3-bedroom villa is AED 2.9M, while 4-bedroom Green Community villas are available at a minimum of AED 3.2M.

Those interested in larger private units, like 5-bedroom Green Community Motor City villas for sale, have to pay from AED 5.5M to AED 8.2M. These properties cover an expansive area of more than 5,000 sq. ft.

Similarly, townhouses for sale in Green Community are a favored option for relatively smaller families. The covered area for villas ranges between 5,400 sq. ft. and 7,075 sq. ft., while prices are comparatively more affordable. A 3-bedroom townhouse is priced at AED 2.9M, and the minimum cost for 4-bedroom houses in Green Community is AED 3.2M. If you want to purchase 5-bedroom townhouses in Green Community (Motor City), expect to invest approximately AED 6.2M.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Green Community Motor City?

data.answer:
Green Community is ideal for families and individuals seeking a peaceful, environmentally conscious environment. Its commitment to sustainability and spacious and modern living arrangements make it a unique and desirable location in Dubai.

Public Transportation in Green Community Motor City

Public transportation in Green Community Motor City Dubai is easily available. There are no metro stations within the area, but you can find bus stops in Green Community Motor City. The nearest metro stations and bus stops to the district are as follows.

NEAREST METRO STATION

  • Emirates Golf Estate Metro Station - 15 minutes away

NEAREST BUS STOPS

  • Discovery Garden 6 Bus Stop
  • Discovery Garden 7 Bus Stop

Supermarkets in Green Community Motor City

Blue Mart Motor City and Waitrose Motor City are the popular supermarkets in the community. Blue Mart is a premier supermarket chain that provides groceries, daily essentials, electronics, and other products and services to its customers across the Middle East. 

On the other hand, Waitrose is a British supermarket chain where you can find everything from food products to delicatessens. The store is located in the heart of Motor City, near the Dubai Autodrome. Carrefour, B2B Supermarket, Viva Supermarket, and LIFECO Supermarket are the other options available nearby for the convenience of residents.

Malls In Green Community Motor City Dubai

You can find a couple of retail options inside the neighborhood and in the larger Motor City community. 15 minutes away from the Green Community is the First Avenue Mall. Located in Motor City, it is a preferred retail destination for the residents. The mall's architecture prominently reflects Arabesque influences. Spanning an impressive 500,000 sq. ft., the two-floor facility encompasses 50 high-street retail stores and boasts an indoor-outdoor boulevard.

Approximately a 15-minute from the area, City Centre Me'aisem is an ideal family-friendly destination. Situated in Dubai Production City, this vibrant mall hosts a range of high-street fashion brands, home and electronic stores, and a Carrefour Hypermarket. Notable dining options within the mall include Paul Bakery and Restaurant, Leila, Gazebo, and Starbucks.

Another well-received shopping center, DAMAC Mall, is located about 11 minutes from Green Community. This establishment houses retail outlets, supermarkets, medical centers, and community stores. Along with 40 retail and 10 F&B outlets, DAMAC Mall also provides ample visitor parking space.

Mudon Community Center, situated in the Mudon community, is just 5 minutes from DAMAC Hills. It houses a selection of cafes, restaurants, and retail stores featuring local and international brands.

Schools and Nurseries in Green Community

Several educational institutions are conveniently situated within and close to the community. Nearby nurseries include Emirates British Nursery, Jebel Ali Village Nursery, Building Blocks Nursery, and Child Enrichment Centre

Similarly, there is a diverse range of school options near Green Community Motor City, including GEMS United School, GEMS Metropole School, and Victory Heights Primary School. GEMS United School, located in Dubai Sports City, and GEMS Metropole School, in Uptown Motor City, are a few minutes' drive away.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Green Community Motor City

Green Community Motor City is home to Al Adel Mosque, the community mosque. Additionally, residents have convenient access to places of worship, such as Sharbatly Mosque, Masjid Hasan Abbas, and Al Eman Mosque, all reachable within 3 to 5 minutes.

Mitchem is the closest option for those seeking churches near Green Community, located about 21 minutes away in Dubai Investments Park. The Gatekeepers Weekday Warehouse, Seventh Day Adventist Church, and Emirates Baptist Church are the other nearest options for residents of Green Community.

Clinics and Hospitals in Green Community Motor City

Prominent clinics and hospitals near Green Community comprise Medcare Medical Centre, Crystal White Specialty Dental Clinic, Prime Medical Center, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital, Dr. Tazeen Gynecologist and Polyclinic, and Plato Chiropractic Health Clinic.  

Situated in The Ribbon Mall, Medcare Medical Centre is renowned for its comprehensive healthcare services. It offers a wide spectrum of medical expertise from bariatric surgery and dermatology to cardiology, E.N.T., family medicine, general practice, neurosurgery, pediatrics, physiotherapy, and orthopedics.

Location & Nearby Areas

Green Community Motor City is positioned between Victoria Heights and Arabian Ranches, with neighboring communities including Dubai Sports City to the west, Arabian Ranches 2, and residential sub-communities in Arabian Ranches 1 to the east. Furthermore, Dubai Studio City lies south, and Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) is north of Green Community.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Green Community

data.answer:
Green Community Motor City offers a variety of activities and amenities to cater to different interests. You can stroll through the well-maintained parks and green spaces within the community and visit the lakes and water features in the community. Many of these areas offer picturesque views and a tranquil setting for relaxation. Moreover, you can attend various international and local motorsport events at Dubai Autodrome, attracting professional drivers and teams worldwide.

Residents can discover the diverse culinary scene in Green Community Motor City by trying out the local restaurants and cafes or exploring shopping options at nearby malls such as Ribbon Mall, City Centre Me'aisem, and DAMAC Mall. 

Green Community Motor City Restaurants & Bars

Green Community Motor City offers various dining options, from casual cafes to more formal restaurants. These establishments cater to various tastes, offering diverse cuisines to suit the preferences of residents and visitors.

Experience the warm and inviting ambiance of SanSation, the Mediterranean restaurant in the Green Community. Indulge in a varied and delicious menu featuring a range of options, from succulent kebabs to fresh seafood and vegetarian alternatives, all meticulously prepared with the finest ingredients.

Also, the homegrown favorite, Operation Falafel, has a branch in Green Community. Discerning foodies won’t be disappointed with the extensive menu at Operation Falafel. Some dishes worth trying include classic falafel served with tartar sauce. But if you’re looking for something more interesting, try the stuffed falafel filled with onions, pine nuts, and sesame seeds. Johnny Rockets Motor City.

The cafes in and near Green Community are The Lime Tree Cafe & Kitchen and Friends Avenue Café. You'll also find a selection of other cafes and bars, including Kickers Sports Bar, which offers an outdoor seating arrangement and late-night meals. Moreover, residents can visit Birdies Sports Bar in the Arabian Ranches Golf Club, The Kana Café, Circle Café, and Caporilli’s.

Beaches Near Green Community Motor City

Several beaches are conveniently located near Green Community Motor City. The renowned Jumeirah Beach is just a 25-minute drive away. Marina Beach, known for its various activities and the iconic Ferris wheel, is less than a 30-minute drive from the town.

Hotels in Green Community Motor City

9 minutes away from Green Community is the Studio One Hotel. It is a boutique establishment characterized by a modern and artistic theme, aligning seamlessly with the vibrant and media-centric atmosphere of Dubai Studio City. Boasting a 4-star rating, the hotel features 141 bedrooms, 19 extended-stay studios and apartments, as well as rooms designed to accommodate individuals with special needs.

Boasting a fantastic position with captivating views of the Dubai Autodrome Racetrack and the striking Dubai Marina skyline, Park Inn by Radisson in Dubai Motor City provides an excellent setting for business and leisure travelers. The hotel is conveniently linked to the First Avenue Mall and offers a unique and accessible experience.

Nestled in the central hub of Dubai Sports City, Treppan Hotel & Suites By Fakhruddin provides contemporary and spacious lodging options. Park Inn by Radisson and Treppan Hotel & Suites by Fakhruddin are about 15 minutes from the Green Community Motor City.

Attractions in Green Community Motor City

Green Community Motor City and its surrounding areas offer several landmarks and attractions. One of the notable points of interest near the community is the Dubai Autodrome. Also, Dubai Miracle Garden, a stunning flower garden featuring elaborate displays and designs, is 10 minutes from the area.

Moreover, Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club is a prestigious venue for equestrian events and activities and is a 10-minute drive from the Green Community. The Els Club, a championship golf course designed by professional golfer Ernie Els, is 11 minutes from the district.

These landmarks and attractions contribute to the overall appeal of Green Community Motor City, creating a well-rounded environment for residents and visitors. Other prominent landmarks near Green Community Motor City are Trump International Golf Course and Clubhouse, Jumeirah Golf Estate Clubhouse, and Address Montgomerie.

Green Community offers a lifestyle perfect for those seeking tranquility without the hustle and bustle of city streets. This might not align with your expectations if you prefer being near vibrant city lights and towering structures.

Residents can rely on private vehicles until a well-established public transport system is in place. Nevertheless, taxi services are readily available, and booking a cab online is a convenient alternative for transportation.

more_info.question: FAQs About Green Community Motor City

data.answer:
What is the difference between Green Community Motor City and Green Community DIP?

A Union Properties project, Green Community is a sub-community in Motor City. Directly accessible from Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), it provides various housing options, including villas, townhouses, and terraced apartments.

Green Community in Dubai Investment Park is being developed by Properties Investment. This neighborhood showcases standalone villas, townhouses, and apartments available on a leasehold basis.

Is Green Community Motor City a pet-friendly community?

It is an ideal place for pet lovers, as it features pet-friendly residences and parks where you can take your furry friend for a walk or play fetch.

What are the popular sub-communities in Motor City?

Besides Green Community Dubai, Uptown Motor City, Oia Residence, and Eden Partment are the most popular sub-districts in the area.

Where is Green Community located?

Green Community is located in Dubai Investment Park, Dubai, UAE.

What types of properties are available in Green Community?

Green Community offers villas, townhouses, and apartments.

Are there good schools in Green Community?

Yes, there are several reputable schools in and around Green Community.

What amenities are available in Green Community?

Amenities include parks, swimming pools, gyms, retail centers, and dining options.

How is the transportation in Green Community?

The community is well-connected by road, with access to major highways and public transportation options nearby.

Is Green Community a good place for families?

Yes, Green Community is known for its family-friendly environment, with ample green spaces and recreational facilities.

Are there any future developments planned for Green Community?

Future developments and enhancements are periodically planned, focusing on infrastructure and community facilities.

data.content:
Green Community is a tranquil, family-friendly area located in Motor City. Like its namesake in Dubai Investment Park, it features luxury villas, townhouses, and spacious apartments, offering breathtaking community views. These homes are set amidst picturesque landscapes and scenic lakes, fostering a sense of peace and harmony with nature.

Green Community has many family-friendly amenities, including kids' play areas, fitness clubs, ample parking, and an array of retail and leisure options. Residents enjoy a peaceful lifestyle in this gated community, away from the hustle and bustle of city life.

Motor City is known for its exceptional motorsports facilities and is home to the highly coveted motorsports circuit, Dubai Autodrome. A project of Union Properties, the area is located next to Dubai Studio City and Dubai Sports City and is part of the larger Dubailand development. The neighborhood is easily accessible through Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.
